data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a significant gross prior year reserve release of GBP 132.237 million in 2019, representing a 50.1% reduction of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development was driven by positive reserve movements on the 2017 and prior years of account, with the 2017 year of account showing an improvement of GBP 5.2 million on closed year reserves due to robust pure year reserves and positive claims development. However, the 2018 year of account experienced some adverse development, particularly in Property binders due to deteriorations in reserves from Hawaii lava flow and California Wildfire losses, as well as large losses in Aviation from Ethiopian Airlines and Lion Mentari Airlines, though these were mitigated by reinsurance. Overall, the claims environment was quieter, with a reduction in attritional losses contributing to the release.
